What We Thought About Each Place 19:13 Sync to video time Description We Thought We Knew Europe—Until We Visited the Balkans 978Likes35,672ViewsNov 82025 Ep.179 Most people never picture this part of Europe. Once overlooked during the Cold War and later reshaped by the breakup of Yugoslavia, these four countries—Croatia, Montenegro, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina—and Albania (all part of the Balkans) are rewriting what it means to travel the continent. We share what surprised us most about life here: the warmth of strangers, the layers of history still visible in the streets, and the kind of beauty you can’t capture on postcards. From bunkers and bridges to seaside towns and mountain fortresses, this is the side of Europe few travelers talk about… and the one that changed how we see it forever. ❤️ 🎥 We loved the Balkan countries!
